definition: Adi Vaani is a large language model-based translator tool developed around tribal languages in India.
details: It was launched on 1 September 2025 by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and provides translation services for four languages: Gondi, Bhili, Mundari, and Santali. Adi Vaani is billed as a means of preserving Adivasi heritage while improving access to education, healthcare, and civil services.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Adi Vaani — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
